svg.title: Thirty days from buyer interviews to first 10 MRR logos
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-mvp-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days from buyer interviews to first 10 MRR logos; subtitle: Four weekly validation, multi-tenant build, outbound & retention gates; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 2-9 month ramp applies to stabilized recurring cohorts.; caption: Never spend three months coding in isolation: validate paid pilot commitments in Week 1 and ship a metered multi-tenant wedge by Day 14.; stages: label: Validate & pre-sell; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Mine G2/technographic pain, interview 15 buyers, demo clickable scan, and lock >=3 paid pilot LOIs.; label: Ship metered MVP; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Deploy Postgres RLS, ZDR model router, Redis token caps, semantic cache, and Stripe hybrid billing.; label: Launch scanner GTM; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Activate pilot logos in <5 minutes, run WCAG/churn-scanner outbound, and publish vs-incumbent pages.; label: Audit NRR & scale; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit unsubsidized token margin per tenant, enable smart dunning, and apply Day-30 Kill/Scale rules.

text.title: Thirty days from buyer interviews to first 10 MRR logos
text.tspan: Thirty days from buyer interviews to first 10 MRR logos

circle.title: label: Validate & pre-sell; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Mine G2/technographic pain, interview 15 buyers, demo clickable scan, and lock >=3 paid pilot LOIs.
label: Ship metered MVP; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Deploy Postgres RLS, ZDR model router, Redis token caps, semantic cache, and Stripe hybrid billing.
label: Launch scanner GTM; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Activate pilot logos in <5 minutes, run WCAG/churn-scanner outbound, and publish vs-incumbent pages.
label: Audit NRR & scale; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit unsubsidized token margin per tenant, enable smart dunning, and apply Day-30 Kill/Scale rules.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 2-9 month ramp applies to stabilized recurring cohorts.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 2-9 month ramp applies to stabilized recurring cohorts.
